simple.summary: יְמוּאֵל (Yᵉmûwʼêl) means Jemuel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Exod 6 15.

definitions.full: H3223. Yemuel יְמוּאֵל proper name, masculine son of Simeon Gen 46:10 ; Exod 6:15 ( ᵐ5 Ιεμουηλ ) = נְמוּאֵל (q. v.) Num 26:12 ; 1Chr 4:24 .
